name: Mythic Improved Shield Bash (Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
You use your shield for offense almost as much as defense.

Prerequisites: Improved Shield Bash, Shield Proficiency, 2nd mythic tier.

Benefit(s): You can make a shield bash attack as a swift action.
